thread:
alice: Heads up — we're planning a gentle sunset for the v1 API next month. Need a short one-pager, customer-facing language, and migration snippets (py + ts + embed checks). I opened a docs PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4823. Who can take what?

ben: I can own SDK migration snippets (py + ts). I'll also add a compat example for model alias fallbacks. Need an example for embedding dim mismatch fallback — support flagged that as high-risk.

cara: I'll update the TS SDK snippets and the quickstart example. Note: v2 renamed a few params (`model` -> `model_id`), so I'll add a tiny compat wrapper. Quick snippet below (will paste into PR):

cara: ```ts
// compat wrapper for legacy invoke sites
export function fromLegacyInvoke(legacy: any) {
  return {
    model_id: legacy.model || legacy.model_id,
    input: legacy.input || legacy.text,
  }
}
```

sam: I'll write the one-pager + customer email copy. Couple questions: what do we recommend for fallback strategy? Pin model versions? Also do we want to include an example support script to detect embed dim regressions?

ben: Recommend: pin model versions + enable `fallback_models` policy. Runtime team will expose `fallback_models` config in the next release (v0.9.1) — ETA ~4 days. We'll add a sample config file for it. For embed dim mismatches, we should include a CLI check and a short migration snippet that converts old vectors if feasible.

ryan: Support already found ~7 customers who will be affected by embed dim changes. We need: 1) clear migration guidance, 2) a detection script, 3) canned responses for support. Can we add a small CLI: `ri-migrate check-embeds --project my-app` that reports dims + a suggested action?

docs-bot: Reminder: docs PRs must include a changelog entry, a snippet smoke test, and an owner in the PR description.

cara: Adding the TS compat snippet into the PR now. I'll also add a short example showing `try { invoke(v2) } catch { fallback to v1 }` pattern.

ben: I'll add the Python variant and a short example showing `fallback_models`. Example config:```yaml
# runtime config snippet
fallback_models: ["redwood-3b-quant", "redwood-2b-compat"]
priority: latency
```

sam: Draft customer email (short):
"Hi — in 30 days we'll deprecate the v1 inference API. Most apps will continue working if you pin a model version or enable the recommended fallback policy. See our migration guide for quick code snippets and an automated check tool. Contact support if you see any embed dimension issues; we'll help migrate your vectors."

alice: Nice. Action items: @cara add TS snippet into `/guides/migration/compat-snippets.md`, @ben add py snippet + runtime config example, @sam finalize email and post to #marketing for review, @ryan write the support playbook and canned replies. I'll track rollback safeguards with product (we should document server-side `409` behavior and recommend retry/backoff).

ben: Also adding a quick rollback guard snippet — server returns 409 with header `x-ri-deprecation` when a request hits a retired route. Suggested client behavior (py):

ben: ```py
resp = client.invoke(...)
if getattr(resp, 'status_code', None) == 409 or resp.headers.get('x-ri-deprecation'):
    # fallback to legacy endpoint while we investigate
    legacy = LegacyClient(token=LEGACY_TOKEN)
    resp = legacy.invoke(...)
```

ryan: I'll create the support playbook with detection queries for our observability stack and add the canned customer messages. Will ping legal for wording if needed.

alice: Timeline: aim to have PRs ready by Wed EOD, merge docs Thu, deploy staging Fri, soft email Sat morning. Can everyone confirm they can hit Wed EOD? :pray: 

cara: on it :+1:

ben: Yep, adding tests now.

sam: Yep — will post email in #marketing when ready.

docs-bot: PR 4823 updated: changelog added, smoke tests queued.

alice: Thanks all — I'll follow up with a short checklist and assign owners in the PR. If anyone hits blockers, drop them here and we'll reassign.

ben: FYI I'll also add a small note in the SDK README about the `compat` helpers so downstream examples stay stable.

ryan: Support playbook draft will be in the PR as `support/embeds-migration.md`. I'll include example queries and a triage checklist.

alice: Perfect. Closing loop for now — I'll move the draft to `ready-for-review` in the docs repo once the snippets are in. :rocket:
